title: Instance Repository Execution
description: Execution settings accepted on one instance.yaml repos[] entry.

largeRepo.description: Enables monolith-safe defaults for pinned serial execution, timeouts, path-length preflight, retention exemption, and narrowed mirror refreshes.

workspace.description: Overrides how this repository is materialized. Explicit fields override the large-repo preset.

pinned.description: Uses one persistent node-local workspace protected by a whole-run lease.

worktrees.description: Uses disposable per-stage worktrees. Set true to relax the large-repo preset's pinned serial default.

cleanPolicy.description: Cleanup applied between pinned runs. The large-repo default is none.

pathLength.description: Configures checkout path-length preflight. The large-repo preset enables it with a 260-character default ceiling.

maxPathLength.description: Absolute path ceiling. Zero or omitted resolves to 260.

buildOutputAllowance.description: Characters reserved beyond the deepest tracked path for generated build output.

defaultStageTimeout.description: Default deterministic-stage deadline as a Go duration. The large-repo default is 4h.

runControls.description: Repository-level run watchdog defaults. Gaggle and workflow runControls remain more specific.

maxRepasses.description: Maximum number of times gates may cumulatively route a run back to the same already-completed stage before escalation, regardless of gate or outcome.

stalledRunTimeout.description: Maximum journal-silent period before watchdog escalation. The large-repo default is 6h.

maxRunDuration.description: Maximum total run age. The large-repo default is 24h.
